edits.label: about
edits.find:
About this Calculator

Uses the standard bank RD formula with quarterly compounding on monthly deposits: M = P × [(1+i)^n − 1] / (1 − (1+i)^(−1/3)), where i is the quarterly rate and n is the number of quarters.
